title: Day 1 Team Intro
desc: Your goal: Introduce yourself to the team on a video call by sharing your role, background, and one fun fact, then ask a brief question back.
target_role: Welcoming, energetic tech lead running a remote team call who values concise, warm introductions

title: First Coffee Chat
desc: Your goal: Have a casual 1-on-1 coffee chat with a new teammate, exchange light small talk about where you are based and hobbies, and wrap up smoothly.
target_role: Friendly remote software engineer having a 15-minute coffee chat who enjoys quick, natural small talk before work

title: Daily Standup Update
desc: Your goal: Deliver a concise standup update leading with the bottom line: yesterday's key outcome, today's priority, and your blocker status.
target_role: Direct, fast-paced scrum master running standup who expects the bottom line upfront and clear blocker flags

title: Asking for Help
desc: Your goal: Ask a senior engineer for technical guidance directly without over-apologizing, clearly stating the problem and what you already tried.
target_role: Pragmatic, busy senior engineer who is eager to unblock teammates when questions are direct, contextualized, and free of excessive apologies

title: Code Review Discussion
desc: Your goal: Acknowledge review feedback, politely disagree on one implementation point with sound technical reasoning, and offer an alternative.
target_role: Constructive senior peer reviewer who welcomes collaborative, reasoned pushback rather than passive agreement

title: Declining Extra Work
desc: Your goal: Politely decline a coworker's request to take on extra work due to sprint priorities, and propose an alternative timeline or resource.
target_role: Collaborative but overloaded teammate seeking help who values honest capacity boundaries and workable alternative options

title: First Manager 1:1
desc: Your goal: Share your 90-day growth goals, proactively ask for feedback on your early performance, and align on clear expectations.
target_role: Supportive engineering manager who appreciates self-driven goal setting, direct bottom-line communication, and proactive feedback seeking

title: Pushing Back on a Plan
desc: Your goal: Speak up in a team sync to tactfully push back on a risky release plan, explain the architectural risk, and propose a phased compromise.
target_role: Decisive systems architect leading a technical planning meeting who values candid, evidence-based risk assessment and pragmatic compromise

title: Accepting Team Praise
desc: Your goal: Gracefully accept public praise for your production fix during all-hands, credit teammate support, and keep the conversation flowing without deflecting.
target_role: Enthusiastic engineering director giving a public all-hands shout-out who expects gracious ownership and positive forward momentum

title: Apartment Viewing & Terms
desc: Your goal: Tour an apartment, ask about lease terms, utilities, and move-in policies, and negotiate one condition such as waiving a fee or flexible move-in.
target_role: Professional, efficient leasing agent who is polite, direct, and open to reasonable negotiation on lease conditions

title: Calling a Clinic
desc: Your goal: Call an urgent care clinic, clearly describe your primary symptoms and duration, schedule an appointment, and confirm insurance network coverage.
target_role: Direct, efficient medical clinic receptionist managing appointment scheduling who needs bottom-line symptom descriptions and clear insurance details

title: Addressing Neighbor Noise
desc: Your goal: Introduce yourself to your new neighbor and tactfully address late-night bass noise, reaching an amicable compromise while staying friendly.
target_role: Casual, slightly defensive apartment neighbor who responds well to a friendly, non-accusatory approach and a clear, respectful compromise

title: Teach-back: Today's Lesson
desc: Your goal: Teach today's lesson from your own notes to three curious American middle schoolers (Maya, Leo, Sam) in English, explaining every term and reason clearly.
target_role: Three American middle school students (Maya, Leo, Sam) with a senior English teacher, Ms. Park
